t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. African Republic) Toy i yan kajim o alla lom nda kam doiti i ki lom ndi bor kadi-te i yan kem-sa tar lom kok roiti i mad kram U koum to ndo lom anei i yan kajim ho, i yan ngom-m ho kam douniante nei ho kam kon-be-te loi ho. Rota i alla ke maj, nan yan-guer loi i ke boo nan toi degue toube.
